items.q: What products does MK AluPlast offer?
items.a: We offer high-quality PVC and aluminium windows, doors, sliding systems, security doors, shutters, flyscreen systems, railings, partition walls and outdoor shade systems for residential and commercial projects.

items.q: Do you provide both PVC and aluminium solutions?
items.a: Yes. We specialise in both PVC and aluminium systems, giving our clients durable, energy-efficient and modern solutions for every type of property.

items.q: Can I order custom-made windows and doors?
items.a: Yes. All our products can be tailored to your required dimensions, style, colour and opening system.
Yes. Our windows are designed to provide excellent thermal insulation, helping reduce heat loss and improve energy efficiency in your home or building.

items.q: Can you help improve thermal insulation and noise reduction?
items.a: Yes. Our PVC and aluminium windows and doors are designed to improve insulation and reduce outside noise, depending on the selected system and glazing.

items.q: How can I request a quote?
items.a: Send us your project details: the type of product, approximate dimensions, your preferences and the location. We will arrange a measurement visit and prepare a personalised quotation.
